hero.title: About
hero.description: Nitriansky technologický inkubátor is a student-focused innovation platform at UKF Nitra. We help students turn ideas into products and connect them with real companies.

education.title: Education
education.desc: We provide practical workshops, seminars, and regular professional consultations.

incubation.title: Incubation
incubation.desc: We transform innovative ideas into viable solutions and starting businesses.

networking.title: Networking
networking.desc: We bridge the gap between talented university students and tech companies.

opportunities.label: Who we are
opportunities.title: Built for students, by UKF
opportunities.students_desc: NTI is open to all students of UKF Nitra who want to work on real tech projects. Whether you have a startup idea or want to gain commercial experience — there's a program for you.
opportunities.companies_desc: Companies can submit projects to our backlog. NTI matches them with motivated student teams, coordinates the process, and ensures quality output with mentor supervision.
